worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 50,850.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 4,000.00 = 54,850.00. Federal taxable income = 54,850.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 39,100.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Illinois starts from federal AGI). Form IL-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 54,850.00. Line 2 federally tax-exempt interest 0.00. Line 3 other additions 0.00. Line 4 = 54,850.00. Line 5 0.00. Lines 6 and 7 0.00. Line 8 = 0.00. Line 9 base income = 54,850.00 - 0.00 = 54,850.00. Income Exceptions: federal AGI 54,850.00 is not greater than 250,000.00, so the allowance stands. Line 10a 2,850.00. Line 10b 0.00. Lines 10c and 10d 0.00. Line 10 = 2,850.00. Line 11 net income = 54,850.00 - 2,850.00 = 52,000.00. Line 12 tax = 52,000.00 x 4.95% = 2,574.0000. Lines 13-18 0.00 (no credits in the projection). Line 19 state income tax = 2,574.00. Schedule M Line 22 not applied in the projection. The booklet would subtract 4,000.00: Line 11 = 48,000.00, tax 2,376.00; the projection overstates tax by 198.00 (4.95% x 4,000.00).
accepted_approximations: Interest on U.S. Treasury and agency obligations and on U.S. retirement bonds is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
